protocol.title: Automated Digital Microfluidic Platform for Magnetic-Particle-Based Immunoassays with Optimization by Design of Experiments
protocol.platform: Automated DMF (digital microfluidics) with integrated PMT and magnetic lens
protocol.objective: Automated magnetic-particle-based sandwich immunoassay for TSH with DOE-optimized protocol; first report of DOE optimization for immunoassays in any microfluidic system

device.form_factor: Benchtop enclosure, approx. 18 x 23 x 30 cm, light-tight

electronic_interface.loading: motor-driven lowering onto device contact pads

positions.engaged: several hundred micrometers above device surface

integrated_pmt.shutter: closed in disengaged state; opens on engagement
integrated_pmt.actuation: motor-driven with two optical limit switches
integrated_pmt.software: EM6 counter timer software via CT2 counter timer module (ET Enterprises)

magnetic_lens.name: magnetic lens

armatures.function: field directors focusing flux to pole tips

magnetic_lens.actuation: motor-driven vertical with two optical limit switches
magnetic_lens.modeling_software: COMSOL (Burlington, MA); 3D model, magnetic fields and no currents

particle_model.pellet_geometry: sphere with volume = single particle volume x particle count

advantages_over_disc_magnet: Localized field (<35 uN force at >4 mm from center); minimizes unintended particle attraction
Stronger vertical force in separation zone (exponential increase as gap decreases)
Vertical motor engagement eliminates horizontal disc movement that causes stray attraction
Supports up to 8 simultaneous parallel magnetic separations vs. 2 for disc magnet

paramagnetic_particles.diluent: DMF-compatible particle diluent (pH 10): Tris base 6.1 g/L, NaCl 5.8 g/L, BSA 1% w/v, thimerosal 0.05% w/v, Pluronic L64 0.05% v/v

tsh_standards.additive: Pluronic L64 0.05% v/v (added prior to use)

chemiluminescent_substrate.additive: Pluronic L64 0.025% v/v (added prior to use)

pluronic_l64.supplier: BASF Corp., Germany (donated by Brenntag Canada, Toronto, ON)
pluronic_l64.use: DMF compatibility additive in standards and substrate

steps.name: Paramagnetic particle dispense and immobilization
steps.magnetic_lens: engaged (~150 um gap); particles pellet on device surface above magnet
steps.notes: Particle diluent supernatant moved away by electrode actuation; pellet immobilized for sample delivery. Magnetic lens facilitates up to 8 simultaneous separations across device.

steps.name: TSH sample dispense and pooling (5 unit droplets)
steps.doe_optimization: 5 droplets selected as optimal by 3^3 full factorial DOE (highest Sqrt(SBR) across all concentrations)
steps.notes: Five unit droplets dispensed individually and chained via sequential mix operations to accumulate 4 uL pooled sample.

steps.name: Sample incubation with immobilized particles
steps.mixing_mode: circular shuttle across 4+ electrodes (continuous active mixing, 100-120 Vrms, 10 kHz)
steps.doe_optimization: 3 min selected as optimal (not 6 min from prototype); negative vol x inc interaction means longer incubation at high volume reduces Sqrt(SBR)
steps.notes: Rapid continuous mixing enables faster analyte binding kinetics than prototype setup (hand-held probes). Key DOE result: con x inc negative coefficient at high TSH; 3 min outperforms 6-9 min across all concentrations when volume is maximized.

steps.name: Post-sample wash series (4 cycles)
steps.magnetic_lens_state: engaged for pellet immobilization; disengaged for resuspension
steps.purpose: Remove unbound TSH and non-specific binders from particle surface

steps.name: HRP-conjugate delivery and incubation
steps.purpose: HRP-antibody binds to TSH captured on particle surface (sandwich formation)

steps.name: Post-conjugate wash series (4 cycles)
steps.critical_note: Supernatant removed IMMEDIATELY after final wash (no queue wait). Pilot assays showed up to 45% signal decay when particles queued in wash buffer before measurement. Optimized protocol eliminates this delay entirely.

steps.name: Chemiluminescent substrate reaction
steps.mixing_mode: active electrode mixing (replaces pilot: 40 s mix + 100 s static incubation)
steps.purpose: HRP catalyses luminol oxidation by H2O2; signal reaches stable plateau after 4 min continuous mixing, enabling sequential PMT reads within ~1 min window without signal drift

steps.name: PMT chemiluminescence detection
steps.pmt_state: engaged (motor-lowered, shutter open, several hundred um above device)
steps.calibration: linear fit; LOD = mean(blank) + 3 x SD(blank)

doe_analysis.midlevels_rationale: vol=3 droplets and inc=6 min match prototype setup optimal parameters (Ng et al. 2012)
doe_analysis.response_transform: square-root (Box-Cox confirmed power ~0.5 minimizes sum of squares error)
doe_analysis.model: Modified second-order centered polynomial regression (eq 1 in paper)

fit_statistics.residual_normality: confirmed by Shapiro-Wilk test and normal probability plot

significant_factors.effect: negative quadratic; plateaus at high vol
negative quadratic; plateaus at high con
longer incubation at high vol reduces Sqrt(SBR)
longer incubation at high con reduces Sqrt(SBR)

optimal_parameters.rationale: Maximum Sqrt(SBR) at 4 uIU/mL and at 0.4 uIU/mL (critical for sensitivity); response surface peak at 5 droplets x 3 min (Fig 4D)

performance.clinical_significance: LOD of 0.15 uIU/mL enables screening for hyperthyroidism ([TSH] < 0.3 uIU/mL)

pmt_vs_well_plate_reader.dynamic_range: at least 2 orders of magnitude (both methods)
pmt_vs_well_plate_reader.advantage: Reproducible fixed positioning of PMT relative to device eliminates manual insertion variability

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.content: particle dispense, TSH pooling, sample incubation, 4x post-sample wash, wash QC gate

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.content: conjugate incubation, 4x post-conjugate wash, substrate reaction, PMT detection

bioscript_compiler_notes.ir_output: 7 basic blocks (BB1-BB7), 2 if/else gates, 8 CFG edges

known_compiler_behaviour.multi_unit_dispense: not supported as indexed array; 5 TSH droplets dispensed as 5 scalar variables and chained via sequential mix

bioscript_compiler_notes.wash_variable_threading: Particles carried via wash_Na variables (the resuspension droplet at each cycle); supernatant (washSup, cwashSup) drained. cwash4a feeds directly into H2O2 resuspension step.
